hero.subtitle: Private journeys through the wild heart of the island.

home.introTitle: One company for the whole journey.
home.introBody: Certified guides, accommodation and transport — arranged by us, from your first message to your last morning on the island.
home.servicesTitle: Everything a journey needs, from one place.

services.title: Certified guides
services.short: Our own team, certified by the Sri Lanka Tourism Board.

services.title: Accommodation
services.short: Hotels, boutique stays and eco lodges, booked for you.

services.title: Transport
services.short: Private vehicle, experienced driver, airport to airport.

services.title: Your itinerary
services.short: Built around what you want to see — and adjusted as you go.

home.guideBody: Nandana began in wildlife conservation in 1990, qualified as a national guide in 2002, and founded Nature Walks Sri Lanka in 2017. He still leads tours himself.

tours.sectionTitle: How long would you like to explore Sri Lanka?

customTour.intro: Tell us how you'd like to experience Sri Lanka, and we'll shape a private journey around it — guide, accommodation and transport included.
customTour.resumeTitle: Pick up where you left off?
customTour.resumeBody: We saved the trip you were planning on this device.
customTour.travelersHint: Between 1 and 12 travellers on a private journey.
customTour.datesLabel: When would you like to travel?
customTour.datesHelp: Pick your arrival date, then your departure date. We guide year-round, so any dates can be arranged.
customTour.datesHint: Select your arrival, then your departure.
customTour.datesInvalid: Please choose an arrival date and a departure date after it.
customTour.interestsLabel: What are you most interested in?
customTour.interestsHint: Pick one or more. Matching itineraries appear below.
customTour.suggestionsEmpty: Choose a category to see the prebuilt itineraries that match it.
customTour.accommodationHint: Choose one or more styles, or let us recommend something for each stop.

journeyPlan.title: Your journey, stop by stop
journeyPlan.intro: We have put the itineraries you chose into a sensible driving order, starting from the airport, and fitted them to your dates.
journeyPlan.empty: Go back to the Interests step and add at least one itinerary — your journey plan is built from the ones you choose.
journeyPlan.driveLabel: {km} km from the previous stop · about {duration} by road
journeyPlan.totalLabel: {count} stops · about {km} km of driving in total
journeyPlan.overflowNote: Your dates are shorter than the itineraries you chose need. The plan below runs past your departure date — remove an itinerary, or talk to us about extending the trip.
journeyPlan.downloadHint: The same plan as a PDF to read, or a Word file you can edit and send back to us.

customTour.contactHint: So we can reply to you. We keep your enquiry so you can look it up again later, and your answers also go into a WhatsApp message you send yourself.
customTour.requirementsLabel: Tell us about your ideal journey…
customTour.reviewHint: Check everything reads right, then send it over on WhatsApp.
customTour.errorTravelers: Please enter at least one traveller.
customTour.errorInterests: Please choose at least one interest.
customTour.errorContact: Please add your name, a valid email address and a phone number.
customTour.downloadError: We couldn't build the document. Please try again.
customTour.submitHint: Sending on WhatsApp also saves a Word copy of this journey to your device, so you can attach it to the chat.

document.title: Your Sri Lanka journey
document.tagline: Prepared by Nature Walk Sri Lanka
document.notice: This document was generated automatically from the itineraries you told us you were interested in. It is a starting point, not a fixed booking. If anything needs changing — the order of the stops, how long you stay, or the itineraries themselves — talk to our team on WhatsApp. Don't worry: they are always happy to help.

customTour.amending: You are changing trip {reference}. Send it again when you are done and we will see the update.
customTour.amendFailed: We could not open that trip. Open it from your trip page first, then choose Change this trip.

nandana.introTitle: A lifetime spent walking through Sri Lanka.
nandana.whyTitle: A guiding company, not a booking desk.

whyPoints.title: Every guide certified
whyPoints.description: All our guides are certified by the Sri Lanka Tourism Board.

whyPoints.title: Field-trained, not scripted
whyPoints.description: Guiding that grew out of conservation fieldwork, taught by Nandana himself.

whyPoints.title: One company, one journey
whyPoints.description: Guides, stays and transport from us — one number for anything.

sriLanka.title: Rainforest, highland and coast — closer together than you'd expect.
sriLanka.body: From Wilpattu's dry-zone leopard country to Sinharaja's endemic-rich rainforest canopy, from Kandy's hill temples to the reef off Trincomalee, Sri Lanka compresses a continent's worth of habitat into a single island.

conservation.title: Guiding rooted in fieldwork, not just hospitality.
conservation.quote: Nandana began his career with Sri Lanka's Department of Wildlife Conservation and remains a member of the Field Ornithology Group of the University of Colombo — conservation isn't a footnote to our tours, it's where the guiding started.

testimonials.title: From travelers who've walked this route
testimonials.emptyState: Traveler stories are being gathered here — check back soon, or message us on WhatsApp for references.

finalCta.title: Your Sri Lanka begins with a conversation.
finalCta.subtitle: No forms, no wait — message Nature Walks Sri Lanka directly on WhatsApp.

footer.tagline: Private nature and wildlife journeys through Sri Lanka, with certified guides, accommodation and transport arranged throughout.

common.contentRequired: Content required — to be confirmed with Nandana

myTrip.sendFailed: We could not send that link. Check the address and try again.
